acceptance_dimensions.name: threat_model_soundness
acceptance_dimensions.description: An explicit threat model states adversary capabilities, position, and knowledge; every assumption is realistic for the claimed deployment; out-of-scope is declared; all claims stay inside the stated model. FATAL indicators: no identifiable threat model; internally inconsistent assumptions (e.g., attacker writes firmware but cannot read keys); white/gray-box knowledge assumed without deployment justification. BLOCK indicators: scope creep between abstract claims and evaluated setting; missing out-of-scope declaration; assumptions that trivialize the problem.

acceptance_dimensions.name: evaluation_adequacy
acceptance_dimensions.description: Evaluation meets the security community's bar for the paper's subfield. AI-security defenses: evaluated against ADAPTIVE adversaries aware of the defense (Carlini-checklist standard), strongest published attacks correctly tuned, no gradient masking/security-by-obscurity. CPS: real testbed or hardware-in-the-loop, or an explicit simulation-fidelity argument; physical consequence quantified, not packet-level success only. IoT: device/vendor diversity commensurate with generality claims; root cause identified as a vulnerability class vs one vendor's bug. ML-for-security detection: base-rate fallacy addressed, temporally split datasets (no future leakage), false-positive cost at deployment scale. FATAL indicators: defense evaluated only against attacks it was designed to stop; simulation-only where the community expects testbeds with no fidelity argument. BLOCK indicators: weak or mis-tuned baselines; strawman comparisons; component metrics without end-to-end demonstration.

acceptance_dimensions.name: novelty_and_positioning
acceptance_dimensions.description: The delta over recent top-venue (Big-4 + tier-2) prior work is explicit and survives scrutiny; related work is correctly represented; novelty claims are search-bounded, never absolute. FATAL indicators: the core contribution restates a recent Big-4 result without acknowledgment. BLOCK indicators: incremental delta without a positioning argument or table; prior work misrepresented to inflate the gap; unbounded 'first work to' claims.

acceptance_dimensions.name: practical_impact_and_deployment_realism
acceptance_dimensions.description: The security problem matters in real deployments: the attack surface exists in practice, attacker economics are plausible, and defenses account for operator constraints (control-loop latency budgets for CPS, update channels for IoT, compute cost for ML defenses). Impact is stated concretely (affected devices/vendors/systems, physical or financial consequence). BLOCK indicators: attack requires preconditions that already imply game-over access; defense overhead unmeasured or incompatible with the deployment it claims to protect; 'security theater' that relocates rather than reduces attack surface.

acceptance_dimensions.name: ethics_and_disclosure_soundness
acceptance_dimensions.description: Judges the ADEQUACY of the ethics story (Phase-0 checks mere presence): offensive results carry a coordinated-disclosure narrative (who was notified, when, response, CVEs/embargo); measurement studies justify scanning methodology, data minimization, and IRB status or exemption reasoning (IRB approval alone is not sufficient mitigation); human-subjects work states approval; dual-use analysis for released attack tooling. FATAL indicators: undisclosed exploitable vulnerabilities in deployed systems with no disclosure plan; measurement that harmed production systems. BLOCK indicators: disclosure narrative vague on timeline; ethics section boilerplate that names no stakeholders or risks.

acceptance_dimensions.name: reproducibility_and_artifacts
acceptance_dimensions.description: Implementation and artifacts are sufficient for the venue's open-science expectations and eventual artifact evaluation: implementation described (languages, LoC, hardware/testbed inventory), artifacts referenced and anonymized, main claims reproducible from what is provided or a justified exemption stated. BLOCK indicators: headline results depend on unreleased components with no justification; experiment descriptions too thin for an AEC to reproduce the main table.

acceptance_dimensions.name: presentation_and_venue_fit
acceptance_dimensions.description: Two-column conference discipline: structure follows the security-paper convention (threat model, design, evaluation, discussion, ethics); page budget respected; figures legible; numeric citations; the paper reads as a security research contribution appropriate to the target venue rather than an applications paper with security keywords.

failure_conditions.expression: any mandatory dimension has a fatal block
two or more mandatory dimensions score 'warn' or worse
